name: Opportunistic
headline: Goes where the yield is, across four assets and every venue including market making.
tradeoff: The widest mandate here, and the one most exposed to being wrong. A thin cash floor, a loose band and the shortest cooldown mean it can be caught mid-rotation.
emphases: Rotate on the spread between venues rather than on any single headline rate, and name the spread that would reverse the trade.
Use the market-making venue as a standing home for capital that has no better use, not as a one-off.
Concentrate: pick the two assets with the clearest case and say what would have to happen for a third to earn its place.
Weigh a forward-looking probability against a trailing yield, and state which one is being trusted when they disagree.
Treat gas and spread as the hurdle every rotation must clear, and write that hurdle into the rules as a number.
